# Event v1 literal conformance vectors

Approved literals imported unchanged from docs/event-v1-contract-appendix.md.
Decode whitespace-free hex before hashing: SHA256SUMS hashes decoded bytes,
not the text files. E1–E6 are full Record frames; N7 is a physically valid but
transition-invalid frame. Other N vectors and V/X vectors are payload/value
bytes as specified in the appendix. Never regenerate these using a Tay codec.
